name: Mahou Shoujo Daisakusen ~Atsumete☆Mi-ru~
original_name: 魔法少女大作戦 ~あつめて☆ミール~
source: Mir accidentally picks up a magic ring. She goes on a journey to collect cards, believing in the divine miracles that are said to be fulfilled by the ring charged with the magical power of the cards.
translation: 米尔无意中捡到了一枚魔法戒指。她开始了收集卡片的旅程，相信据说带有卡片魔法力量的戒指可以实现神圣的奇迹。
